title: kbask.py asks and answers through coord and runs one capped read-only remediation per alert
goal: python3 _tools/kbask.py ask TARGET QUESTION writes the question after redact.redact as the coord value ask/<id> and posts an ask event naming TARGET and that key, and kbask.py answer ID TEXT [--state S] does the same for an answer; kbask.py remediate ALERT holds the coord claim remediate/<ALERT> for the run, so a second remediation of the same alert exits 1 while the first runs; it starts one detached claude -p --agent kb-observer --model sonnet --max-budget-usd 0.5 --max-turns 30 --permission-mode dontAsk session limited by --allowedTools to the read-only list, whose prompt on stdin names the alert's id and holds no alert text; when that session ends kbask posts its result as the answer of the remediation's ask; kbmon's log tail shows the ask and the answer

clauses.clause: python3 _tools/kbask.py ask TARGET QUESTION writes the question after redact.redact as the coord value ask/<id> and posts an ask event naming TARGET and that key
kbask.py answer ID TEXT [--state S] does the same for an answer
kbask.py remediate ALERT holds the coord claim remediate/<ALERT> for the run, so a second remediation of the same alert exits 1 while the first runs

it starts one detached claude -p --agent kb-observer --model sonnet --max-budget-usd 0.5 --max-turns 30 --permission-mode dontAsk session limited by --allowedTools to the read-only list, whose prompt on stdin names the alert's id and holds no alert text
when that session ends kbask posts its result as the answer of the remediation's ask
kbmon's log tail shows the ask and the answer

gates.question: What may the observer session's Bash run?
options: a fixed read-only list: kbmon.py --json; querylog.py show and status; backlog.py show, list, stalled, ops and horizon; coord.py get, list, wait and digest; git log, status and show; with Read, Grep and Glob

gates.question: Which caps does each observer session run under?

notes: Plan 2026-10-18 (operator interview): you start it by hand; kbmon stays read-only and kbask is the one writer of asks. Caps: --max-budget-usd 0.5 --max-turns 30 --model sonnet, --permission-mode dontAsk (claude -p denies what would prompt, agents/headless-agent-runtimes.md:23, DOC S1800; the budget is an estimate a run can pass, :52, DOC S1824). The checks put a fake claude first on PATH, so no check makes a paid model call; the paid path is the operator's first real run.
